title: Here’s How to Watch UFC 333 Live Online for Free
summary: Live from Abu Dhabi on Oct. 24, you can watch the entire MMA event online for free.
contentText:

After UFC 332 in Salt Lake City, the UFC heads to the UAE for UFC 333. Two prime fighters face off in the championship main event, as Australian fighter Alexander Volkanovski (28-4-0) defends his featherweight title against Russian Movsar Evloev (20-0-0).

Watch UFC 333 with DirectV free trial

And in the co-main event, Russian Petr Yan (20-5-0) takes on Georgian Merab Dvalishvili (21-5-0) for Yan’s bantamweight championship in a title bout.

On Saturday (Oct. 24), UFC 333 takes place at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, with a start time of 10 a.m. ET/7 a.m. PT.

How to Watch UFC 333 Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Saturday, Oct. 24

- Main Event Matchups: Alexander Volkanovski vs. Movsar Evloev; Petr Yan vs. Merab Dvalishvili

- Online Streaming: Paramount+ , DirecTV

What Is the Main Event’s Walkout Music for UFC 333?

Although the UFC has yet to announce each fighter’s walkout songs for UFC 333, they usually go out to the octagon to the same songs during their matches. Volkanovski has walked out to “Down Under” by Men at Work, while Movsar Evloev prefers to walk out to “Melodies of the Mountain” by Sulambek Mamilov.

As for Yan, he typically walks out to “Stem for the Belt” by Noggano and Dvalishvili usually walks out to “Homeland” by Bani.
